assertions.name: b_is_bar_even
assertions.source: b²=(q⁴+q²+1)/(q²+1)²: function of h² (h bar-odd) ⇒ bar-even

assertions.name: no_documented_ck_satisfies_bar_even_law
assertions.source: c₂=-1, c₃=-2-ℏ², c₃=J_Hopf all violate the (unsigned) law

description: Prunes open-axis criterion 2(b) for the Q_β fibre kernel. The canonical Hoefsmit base b(q)=√((h²+3)/(h²+4)) (h=q-q⁻¹) is bar-EVEN, so u=b·ℏ_q² is bar-EVEN-covariant (u→+q²u). The documented c₂=-1 and both c₃ candidates (-2-ℏ², J_Hopf) all VIOLATE the bar-even-kernel law c_k(q⁻¹)=q^(-2k)c_k(q). So criterion 2(b) cannot be imposed on the c_k ladder in u. CORRECTION of an earlier version that used a non-canonical bar-ODD b=(q-q⁻¹)/(q+q⁻¹) (wrong u≈0.00102): the verdict is unchanged but there is no parity-split (u carries no per-rung sign). Constraint/pruning, not a value-hunt; nothing wired. See docs/audits/2026-06-20-hoefsmit-b-bar-parity-correction.md.
